summary: fix(queue): redirect ruff and mypy caches in verification sandbox and clean up empty scratch dirs

delivery.outcome: Redirect RUFF_CACHE_DIR and MYPY_CACHE_DIR into writable scratch cache inside the bubblewrap verification sandbox, prune empty .subactor/cache/koru-verification directories after verification, and reverse the staged unified diff on VERIFY_BASELINE_FAILED so broken-baseline runs do not leak dirty detached-HEAD worktrees.
nonGoals: Do not weaken seccomp or read-only filesystem isolation in verification_sandbox.py.

architecture.decision: Set RUFF_CACHE_DIR and MYPY_CACHE_DIR inside scratch/cache in verification_sandbox._command, prune empty .subactor/cache/koru-verification parent directories in run_verification, and call reverse_unified_diff(staged, plan.diff) when verify fails with an already-failing baseline.
